name: MooncellSentry
author: Mooncell
description: Correlate MediaWiki requests, errors, logs and profiles in Sentry.

MooncellSentryDsn.description: Site DSN. Empty keeps SDK initialization/exception capture disabled (legacy externally initialized clients can still be traced).

MooncellSentryOptions.description: PHP SDK option overrides. Defaults: errors 100%, traces 1%, profiles 10% of sampled traces, SDK logs enabled.
